> **Code of Discourse Notice:** All submissions to the **Real Estate AI Task Force** must focus strictly on **consumer protection, fiduciary accountability, statutory clarity, or technical feasibility**. Submissions focused on commission protectionism, general marketing/virtual staging tools, or commercial software promotion will be closed as off-topic.
